# Gramlot 0.3.36

## Terminal component

- New `terminal` component in the editors collection (#87). xterm 6.0.0 and
  `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0 load on first use through the `libraries`
  manifest, from jsDelivr with integrity checks or from the local copy. The
  page Data receives only `connected`, `rows` and `columns`.
- `@terminal` marks a PageStore method that opens a terminal session; it is
  resolved like `@endpoint` and `@upload` and takes `auth`.
- `TerminalSession` (`gramlot.server.terminal`) with `read()`, `write()`,
  `resized()`, `close()` and `host`. `GramlotServer.open_terminal()` and
  `close_terminal()`; sessions close with their page and on `close_all()`.
- Terminal socket `/gramlot/terminal`: one binary WebSocket message per frame,
  first byte the channel (0 input, 1 output, 4 resize, 5 ack). Output stops
  while 1 MB is unacknowledged.
- `PageStoreConnection.terminalUrl(session)` builds the socket URL.
- The Python adapters offer the socket route (gramlot-py-server); the JS hosts
  do not.
